# Templates

These are the emails we sent in 2026 and 2027. Words in `[brackets]` are placeholders.

Before you send any of them, search the text for last year's edition number, year, city, host and contact address. Copied templates kept the old values more than once.

| Template | Sent by | When |
|---|---|---|
| [Call for papers](cfp-email.md) | Communication chair | First and second call |
| [Speaker invitation](speaker-invitation.md) | Speakers lead | After a speaker accepts |
| [Accepted authors](accepted-authors.md) | Communication chair | After notification |
| [Oral presenters](oral-presenters.md) | Program chairs | After orals are chosen |
| [Registration reminder](registration-reminder.md) | General chair | Before the registration deadline |
| [Sponsorship request](sponsorship-request.md) | Sponsorship chair | After the proposal is accepted |
